description: Read or update mailbox-level settings (idempotent — safe to retry; sets are PATCH-style and merge with existing state). action=`get` (default) returns settings — use `section` to filter (`language`, `timeZone`, `workingHours`, `automaticRepliesSetting`, or `all`). action=`set-auto-replies` configures out-of-office: `enabled` true/false, optional `startDateTime`/`endDateTime` (ISO 8601) for scheduled mode, `internalReplyMessage` and (optionally) `externalReplyMessage`. action=`set-working-hours` updates the schedule: `startTime`/`endTime` (HH:MM) and `daysOfWeek` (array of `monday`..`sunday`). Returns the updated settings object on set actions.

endDateTime.description: End date/time for scheduled mode, ISO 8601 format (action=set-auto-replies)

endTime.description: Work end time in HH:MM format, e.g. '17:00' (action=set-working-hours)

section.description: Specific section to retrieve (action=get, default: all)

startDateTime.description: Start date/time for scheduled mode, ISO 8601 format (action=set-auto-replies)

startTime.description: Work start time in HH:MM format, e.g. '09:00' (action=set-working-hours)

name: mailbox-settings
